t: 随着年轻的瑞典查理十一世的入会,他的摄政开始谈判以结束第二次北方战争.
te: With the accession of young Charles XI of Sweden, his regents begin negotiations to end the Second Northern War.
dz: 随着年轻的瑞典查理十一世的入会,他的摄政开始谈判以结束第二次北方战争.
de: With the accession of young Charles XI of Sweden, his regents begin negotiations to end the Second Northern War.

t: 英国长期议会解散，为新的国民公会议会做准备。
te: The Long Parliament of England is dissolved so as to prepare for the new Convention Parliament.
dz: 英国长期议会解散，为新的国民公会议会做准备。
de: The Long Parliament of England is dissolved so as to prepare for the new Convention Parliament.

t: 大不列颠国王查理二世所宣布的布雷达宣言,除其他外,承诺对英国内战和Interregnum期间所…
te: Declaration of Breda by King Charles II of Great Britain promises, among other things, a general pardon to all royalist…
dz: 大不列颠国王查理二世所宣布的布雷达宣言,除其他外,承诺对英国内战和Interregnum期间所犯之罪行,对所有皇室主义者和君主制的反对者给予大赦.
de: Declaration of Breda by King Charles II of Great Britain promises, among other things, a general pardon to all royalists and opponents of the monarchy for crimes committed during the English Civil War and the Interregnum.

t: 瑞典和波兰建立了奥利瓦条约.
te: Treaty of Oliva is established between Sweden and Poland.
dz: 瑞典和波兰建立了奥利瓦条约.
de: Treaty of Oliva is established between Sweden and Poland.

t: 长索尔特战役在5天后结束,法国殖民民兵与他们的休伦和阿尔贡昆盟友被豪德诺索尔内邦联所击败.
te: The Battle of Long Sault concludes after five days in which French colonial militia, with their Huron and Algonquin all…
dz: 长索尔特战役在5天后结束,法国殖民民兵与他们的休伦和阿尔贡昆盟友被豪德诺索尔内邦联所击败.
de: The Battle of Long Sault concludes after five days in which French colonial militia, with their Huron and Algonquin allies, are defeated by the Haudenosaunee Confederacy.

t: 查尔斯二世应国会邀请登陆多佛,这标志着克伦威尔所宣称的英格兰,苏格兰和爱尔兰联邦的终结并开始了…
te: Charles II lands at Dover at the invitation of the Convention Parliament, which marks the end of the Cromwell-proclaime…
dz: 查尔斯二世应国会邀请登陆多佛,这标志着克伦威尔所宣称的英格兰,苏格兰和爱尔兰联邦的终结并开始了英国君主制的恢复.
de: Charles II lands at Dover at the invitation of the Convention Parliament, which marks the end of the Cromwell-proclaimed Commonwealth of England, Scotland and Ireland and begins the Restoration of the British monarchy.

t: 查理二世被恢复了英格兰,苏格兰和爱尔兰的王位.
te: Charles II is restored to the thrones of England, Scotland and Ireland.
dz: 英语恢复:查理二世被恢复了英格兰,苏格兰和爱尔兰的王位.
de: English Restoration: Charles II is restored to the thrones of England, Scotland and Ireland.

t: 签下英格兰查理一世的死刑令的九名摄政者被绞死,被抽取并被收留.
te: The nine regicides who signed the death warrant of Charles I of England are hanged, drawn and quartered.
dz: 签下英格兰查理一世的死刑令的九名摄政者被绞死,被抽取并被收留.
de: The nine regicides who signed the death warrant of Charles I of England are hanged, drawn and quartered.

t: 在格勒沙姆学院,包括克里斯托弗·怀伦,罗伯特·博伊尔,约翰·威尔金斯等12名男子以及罗伯特·莫…
te: At Gresham College, twelve men, including Christopher Wren, Robert Boyle, John Wilkins, and Sir Robert Moray decide to …
dz: 在格勒沙姆学院,包括克里斯托弗·怀伦,罗伯特·博伊尔,约翰·威尔金斯等12名男子以及罗伯特·莫赖爵士决定寻找后来被称为"皇家学会"的东西.
de: At Gresham College, twelve men, including Christopher Wren, Robert Boyle, John Wilkins, and Sir Robert Moray decide to found what is later known as the Royal Society.

t: 一个女人(无论是玛格丽特·休斯还是安妮·马歇尔)首次出现在英国的公开舞台上,出演了出演莎士比亚…
te: A woman (either Margaret Hughes or Anne Marshall) appears on an English public stage for the first time, in the role of…
dz: 一个女人(无论是玛格丽特·休斯还是安妮·马歇尔)首次出现在英国的公开舞台上,出演了出演莎士比亚出演的戏剧"奥赛罗"(Othello)中的德斯德莫娜.
de: A woman (either Margaret Hughes or Anne Marshall) appears on an English public stage for the first time, in the role of Desdemona in a production of Shakespeare's play Othello.

t: 詹姆斯,约克公爵被法国路易十四封为诺曼底公爵.
te: James, Duke of York is named Duke of Normandy by Louis XIV of France.
dz: 詹姆斯,约克公爵被法国路易十四封为诺曼底公爵.
de: James, Duke of York is named Duke of Normandy by Louis XIV of France.
